title: Case Study Fields
_note: The ACF group for the example CUSTOM POST TYPE (case_study, registered in wp/mu-plugins/pod-case-study-register.php). Exposed to WPGraphQL as caseStudyFields on the CaseStudy type. Field KEYS are site-prefixed ({{SITESLUG}}); field NAMES are the contract the frontend reads (src/lib/cms/case-studies.ts) and MUST NOT change (client, industry, summary, website_url -> websiteUrl, metrics{label,value}). Rename this file to <siteslug>-case-study.json and replace {{SITESLUG}}. Keep, rename, or delete this CPT per client.
